review_candidates.title: Assistant Manager Financial Modelling & Bids
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Established in 2006, Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a global clean energy leader, transforming how the world produces and consumes energy through bold innovation and commercial excellence. Masdar is a clean energy investor, developer and operator, advancing renewable energy projects across key markets and technologies, with a global project portfolio capacity to date of over 65 gigawatts (GW). Jointly owned by TAQA, ADNOC and Mubadala , Masdar is driving the scale-up of renewables worldwide, targeting a portfolio capacity of 100GW by 2030. Job Description To act as the subject matter expert for updating the financial model for all the projects under development by performing activities related to financial modelling and project financial reporting. In addition review the Power Purchase Agreements (PPA's), Shareholder Agreements (SHA's) and the rest of commercial agreements to implement the correspondent commercial inputs in the financial model. Key Accountabilities : Take over and maintain complex financial models in line with internal guidelines. Review and operate complex internally or externally developed models, and map to internal guidelines. Conduct financial analysis, as per project requirements, showcasing risk and projected returns. Carry out scenario testing and sensitivity analysis to assess impact on tariff and/or returns Liaise and explain financial model and associated analysis to internal stakeholders. Support other facets of the financial work streams as instructed Ensure that all financial models are properly validated. Suggest ways for tariff optimization and/or return maximization in projects through financial structuring/engineering Liaise and work closely with the PMO team to get clear understanding of the projects under development and/or construction and align on the proper inputs and considerations for the financial modelling. Ensure proper filing, archiving, and traceability of all financial models built or used. Work with SPV’s in updating of the financial models and ensure cost for such activities is recharged Liaise with the relevant departments to ensure costs projected by PMO team are incorporated in the model Ensure models are updated regularly before they are formally handed over to the portfolio management team. Support the monthly PMO reports in coordination with various functions within DCOO organization. Assist in tax structuring and optimising business case for different jurisdictions Review Request for Proposal (RFP) and Request for Quotation (RFQ) documents. Assist in the preparation of proposal/ bid submission documents Ensure proposal documents comply with client requirements and company standards Ensure on-time submission of compliant and commercially sound proposals Maintain proposal/bid libraries, templates, and proposal content. Contribute towards structuring and reviewing of Project Documents viz. Power Purchase Agreements, Shareholder Agreements, etc, by highlighting commercial and contractual risks and providing suitable mitigants/deviations to protect Masdar interests Support Project Managers in obtaining internal and shareholder approvals by preparing approval materials (IC decks) and addressing stakeholder queries. Support in Partner engagement including structuring Joint Development Agreements/Term Sheets. Compile project financials from assigned projects and combine into reports as per guidelines. Check quality of project financial inputs and ensure compliance against expected standards. Perform benchmarking of actuals and assumptions against broader portfolio and flag anomalies. Assist in preparation of portfolio level business plans and contribute to strategic business planning as per management guidance to ensure long-term growth and competitive advantage. Support in structuring corporate level debt and equity (as maybe required) to minimize the overall cost of capital. Prepare dashboards providing portfolio overview and highlighting key performance indicators (viz, returns, capital allocation and deployment, financing strategy, etc.) of various projects. Build and maintain a network of relevant contacts to support daily activities and long-term objectives of the team. Prepare relevant reports and updates as required and to the desired standard. Provide management information as and when required by the line manager – this includes the production and timely provision of accurate reports in line with reporting schedules. Liaise & collaborate with internal departments (technical, tax, accounting, legal, finance, MSTS, insurance, project delivery team) and external stakeholders (lenders, equity partners, external advisors) and further engage in actions for business & project opportunities to obtain internal approvals. Qualifications Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance or any other relevant field Master's degree in relevant field is preferred Professional qualifications: CFA Level 1 or above is preferred Preferred Experience: 4 - 6 years of experience in financial modelling and/or project financing at a market leading investment bank / advisory firm / developer / financial sponsor Experience in the global power and renewable energy sectors is preferred Experience in big capex outlay projects Job-Specific Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work independently to progress projects and resolve issues Ability to lead and conduct complex financial modelling, valuation, and financial analysis Intermediate knowledge of corporate and structured finance, and debt capital markets Understanding of the financial markets and economics locally and globally Problem Solver Highest standards of Ethics & Compliance and Respect of confidentiality terms and ensure no cross contamination of privileged confidential information from one project to another. Demonstrate at all times, an overriding commitment and responsibility towards HSE and Quality Standards, as well as, protecting Masdar’s Green Hydrogen business secrets, technologies, and Licensor Information, and safeguarding the business against any sort of leaks. Additional Information This role is for candidates to be based in Abu Dhabi As part of the application process, we will collect, store and process personal information about you. Masdar will use your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice , which provides details on the purposes for which your data is processed.

NB : Les candidat(e)s doivent adresser au Directeur National de SOS Village d’Enfants Guinée : une lettre de motivation, un curriculum vitae, une copie des diplômes et des attestations des expériences dans les domaines couverts par le poste (stages, formations etc.), la liste de trois personnes de référence et leur adresse complète. Les dossiers susmentionnés devront être envoyés aux adresses électroniques suivantes : Humaines@sosguinea.org et sos-no@sosguinea.org avec en objet la mention : Candidature au poste SOS /CNPI /2016 La date limite de réception des dossiers est fixée au 03/10/2016 ; seul(e)s les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront contacté(e)s.
